answer: Because the oasis calculation reruns each epoch, the vine weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the glacier settlement publishes the resulting shares. A tight ring of 85 clones thus holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 59% independent neighbours on the funding graph. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
